info.name: Tone API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Tone voice-agent platform API (Core edition). Reverse-engineered from `core/api/v1/*.py` on 2026-05-27. Supersedes the legacy `postman_collection/` directory which targets the pre-v2 schema.

**Auth**: most endpoints require a Bearer JWT. Run `Authentication > Login` first; the test script captures `access_token` into the collection variable.

**Variables**:
- `base_url` — defaults to `http://localhost:8000`
- `access_token`, `refresh_token` — populated by Login/Refresh
- `org_id`, `user_id`, `agent_id`, `channel_id`, `tool_id`, `mcp_server_id` — example UUIDs

Folders mirror the 13 mounted controllers. Each endpoint includes:
- **Success** example (200/201/204)
- **Validation** errors (400 / 422)
- **Auth** errors (401 / 403) where applicable
- **Not found** (404), **Conflict** (409), and other controller-specific raises

⚠ Flagged in folder descriptions: `Call Logs` router is disabled in `main.py:19`; three Organizations endpoints call non-existent service methods; `Tools > update_tool` has a `NameError` bug.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Email/password signup + login, JWT refresh, password reset, email verification, invitation accept. Prefix: `/api/v1/auth`. Most endpoints are public; `change-password` and `me` require Bearer.

item.name: Users & Account
item.description: Profile + org member directory. Prefix: `/api/v1/user`. Requires Bearer. ⚠ `UPDATABLE_PROFILE_FIELDS` whitelist silently drops `phone_number` / `profile` etc.; `avatar_url` cannot be cleared via PATCH (null is treated as omitted).

item.name: Organizations & Members
item.description: Org info, member roster, invite/accept/cancel/resend, role updates, org settings. Prefix: `/api/v1/organization`. ⚠ Three Core endpoints (`accept_invitation`, `validate_invitation`, `accept_invitation_with_password`) call non-existent `AuthService` methods — they 500 at runtime. The `/auth/accept-invitation` route in the Authentication folder is the working v2 path. ⚠ `require_admin_or_owner` middleware is a name-only stub — no actual role check.

item.name: Agents
item.description: Voice agent CRUD with embedded config + tools + MCP servers + knowledge base + phone numbers. Prefix: `/api/v1/agent`. ⚠ `phone_numbers[]` is a declarative replace — omitting a number on update DELETES it. ⚠ Reassigning a phone number across agents returns 409. ⚠ `delete_agent` hard-deletes despite `deleted_at` column existing.

item.name: OAuth Integrations
item.description: 3-legged OAuth flow for Google Calendar / Google Sheets. Prefix: `/api/v1/oauth`. Tokens AES-encrypted at rest; auto-refresh via OAuthService.get_valid_access_token_for_connection. ⚠ State parameter is plaintext `<org>:<user>:<provider>` — no CSRF protection. ⚠ `disconnect` and `get_connection` are NOT org-scoped — cross-org leak by UUID.

item.name: Call Metrics
item.description: Per-call latency, token, and turn metrics for the call analytics modal and trends dashboard. Prefix: `/api/v1/call-metrics`. Each row is upserted by `CallLogService.complete_call` after the pipeline drains. `POST /list` returns a summary view (scalars only) for the table; `GET /{call_id}` returns the same row plus the six per-sample arrays (`ttfb`, `processing`, `llm_usage`, `tts_usage`, `user_bot_latency`, `turns`) for the per-call breakdown modal. Whitelisted filter/sort fields: `agent_name`, `agent_type`, `started_at`, `ended_at`, `duration_seconds`, `call_id`, `llm_provider`, `llm_model`, `stt_provider`, `stt_model`, `tts_provider`, `tts_model`. Filter operators: `equal_to`, `greater_than`, `less_than`, `between`, `in`, `contains`. Unknown fields are silently ignored.
